title: An October Night, In One Of Shreveport's Most Haunted Buildings, With One of the Nation's Most Popular Psychics - NewsBreak
text:
By Greg Atoms ,
2 hours ago
She’s the type of person you instantly recognize, even if you can’t say exactly where you’ve seen her before. She has a unique look, and a lot of charisma. Her name is Theresa Caputo.
Caputo built a television career as a medium on cable TV. Viewers watch her deliver messages from deceased individuals to living relatives on television screens. She established an audience over ten years on cable , as her show aired for multiple seasons on the TLC network.
Her career also includes publishing, as she has authored books about her life and work. She’s documented her experiences communicating with spirits. If television and books weren’t enough, Caputo added touring to the resume.
Now, her national tour has aimed for Shreveport .
See The Long Island Medium At The Shreveport Municipal Auditorium Caputo’s touring production comes to Louisiana this October. Theresa Caputo Live: The Experience takes place October 23rd at the Shreveport Municipal Auditorium . For many in the Shreveport area, the idea of hosting a medium at this venue is quite an interesting proposition.
READ MORE: See the 2026 Geek’d Con Celebrity Lineup
This Shreveport venue is often referred to as one of the most haunted venues in the city. Which is saying something for a city with a lot of haunted structures. Lets not ignore that this show is scheduled for October as well…not just that, but the week before Halloween.
Photo by Phillip Faraone Getty Images One of the nation’s most well known psychic-mediums, in one of Shreveport’s most haunted buildings, in late October? This sounds like something you need to be a part of .
Theresa Caputo Live Experience Format The live production operates as an unscripted , two-hour interactive session. Caputo leaves the stage and roams the venue to deliver readings directly to audience members. The show utilizes a full-stage video display to broadcast the interactions to the entire room. The format ensures visibility for attendees seated anywhere.
Patrons attend the event without guarantees of individual interactions. The structure can create an emotional environment , that can also feature both humor and comfort. Attendees observe the messages provided to the audience during the performance, as they watch the unedited process unfold…with everyone observing the public readings.
